/tmp/owner_decision_T031.txt Decision 5: amendment is binding; Planner must merge into a single unified contract body; Developer must not pick only one layer; if no plan review is recorded, route through triage -> planning -> plan-review. Decision 2 (T031 specific) requires the merged contract to make explicit: append-only raw partitions (ADR-002) + Parquet column layout; acquisition envelope/manifest fields (endpoint alias, retrieval time, request interval, HTTP batch metadata); normalized event identity/content hash excluding observational fields; two raw acquisition envelopes retained and checksummed; manifest accounting split by endpoint alias, logical RPC calls, HTTP requests/batches, response bytes, normalized rows, provider units, Parquet bytes, scanned-empty intervals; dedup by T011 EventKey + normalized content (not by ingestion time / endpoint / block number / filename); conflicting observations retained and halt qualification. Decision 2 also states ADR-002 is not reopened; only re-evaluate when implementation proves two-layer structure cannot satisfy requirements.

recommended_action: Route T031 to the planning lane (Planner -> independent Plan Reviewer), paralleling the T030 path. Planner must merge the 2026-09-16 Owner amendment into a single unified T031 contract body by updating the Outcome / Deliverables / Acceptance / Must-not / References sections of todo/phases/P03-ingestion-and-storage/T031.md, remove the separate `FROZEN_FROM_BASELINE_6C31778` marker plus the top amendment block, and inline Owner Decision 2 verbatim where it changes contract text: (a) T030 = logical schema, T031 = Parquet column/partition/manifest physical layout following ADR-002; (b) append-only raw partitions (ADR-002) with the Parquet column layout carrying the raw envelope/manifest fields (endpoint alias, retrieval time, request interval, HTTP batch metadata) separately from the normalized event identity and content hash; (c) the canonical normalized content hash excludes observational fields so the same chain event fetched from A and B compares equal, while both raw acquisition envelopes are retained and checksummed; (d) manifest accounting split by endpoint alias, logical RPC calls, HTTP requests/batches, response bytes, normalized rows, provider units when reported, Parquet bytes, and explicit scanned-empty intervals; (e) dedup by T011 EventKey + normalized content (not by ingestion time, endpoint, block number alone, or filename); conflicting observations are retained and halt qualification instead of silently overwriting; (f) acceptance requires at least one representative short-range measurement that justifies partition sizing without turning the observed volume into a universal constant. Keep the existing T031 Must-not clauses (no mutate/delete of orphaned raw evidence, no half-written partitions, no filenames as manifests). Add an Implementation status note for any pre-existing unverified implementation in src/robinhood_lp/storage/* analogous to the T030 wording, and reference R13, ADR-002, ADR-010, ADR-011. The merged contract must also preserve an audit trail referencing /tmp/owner_decision_T031.txt as the binding source. Do not bypass planning by editing the contract from the Developer lane. Independent Plan Reviewer must confirm completeness, consistency, and that acceptance was not weakened before the next Developer attempt; plan review only approves contract executability, not implementation, and does not change T031 implementation status. Then re-enter the standard prepare/Developer/Reviewer cycle from the merged contract.
